jp: アイテムに擬態し、冒険者を嘲笑うのが趣味の魔物。しかし擬態がばれた後のことまでは考えていないらしく、ばれるとパニックの末に爆発してしまう。
jp_grezzo: "アイテムに擬態し、冒険者を嘲笑うのが趣味の魔物。しかし擬態がばれた後のことまでは考えていないらしく、ばれるとパニックの末に爆発してしまう。"
en: A demon whose hobby is to mimic items and ridicule adventurers. However, it does not seem to think about what happens after its mimicry is discovered, and when it is, it explodes in a panic.
en_grezzo: "A demon whose hobby is to mimic items and ridicule adventurers. However, it does not seem to think about what happens after its mimicry is discovered, and when it is, it explodes in a panic. "
it: Un mostro che per passatempo si finge un oggetto e si fa beffe degli avventurieri. Pare però che non abbia pensato a che cosa fare quando lo smascherano: appena succede va nel panico e finisce per esplodere.

jp: 海からの恵みを受け取り、海と共に生きる人々。漁師たちの間では亀を海からの遣いと考え、大切に扱う風習がある。
jp_grezzo: "海からの恵みを受け取り、海と共に生きる人々。漁師たちの間では亀を海からの遣いと考え、大切に扱う風習がある。"
en: People living with the sea, reaping the bounty of the sea. Among fishermen, there is a custom to treat turtles with care, as they are considered to be messengers from the sea.
en_grezzo: "People living with the sea, reaping the bounty of the sea. Among fishermen, there is a custom to treat turtles with care, as they are considered to be messengers from the sea. "
it: Gente che raccoglie i doni del mare e con il mare vive. Fra i pescatori c'è l'usanza di considerare le tartarughe messaggere del mare, e di trattarle con ogni riguardo.

jp: 冒険とロマンを求めてイルヴァの大海原をゆく者たち。だが、ロマンだけでは食っていけないため定期的に商船を襲う。
jp_grezzo: "冒険とロマンを求めてイルヴァの大海原をゆく者たち。だが、ロマンだけでは食っていけないため定期的に商船を襲う。"
en: Those who travel the great seas of Irva in search of adventure and romance. But romance alone is not enough to feed them, so they regularly attack merchant ships.
en_grezzo: "Those who travel the great seas of Irva in search of adventure and romance. But romance alone is not enough to feed them, so they regularly attack merchant ships. "
it: Gente che solca il grande mare di Irva in cerca di avventura e di romanticismo. Ma di solo romanticismo non si campa, e così ogni tanto assaltano una nave mercantile.

jp: サウスティリスに住む一般市民。依頼で腐った食べ物を渡されたり、魔物をけしかけられてミンチになったりしながらも、彼らは今日もたくましくイルヴァを生き抜いている。
jp_grezzo: "サウスティリスに住む一般市民。依頼で腐った食べ物を渡されたり、魔物をけしかけられてミンチになったりしながらも、彼らは今日もたくましくイルヴァを生き抜いている。"
en: Ordinary citizens living in South Tyris. They are often given rotten food on their request, or beaten to a pulp by demons, but they are still surviving in Ylva today.
en_grezzo: "Ordinary citizens living in South Tyris. They are often given rotten food on their request, or beaten to a pulp by demons, but they are still surviving in Ylva today. "
it: Cittadini comuni che abitano a Tyris del Sud. C'è chi per un incarico si vede consegnare cibo marcio e chi finisce tritato da un mostro aizzato contro di lui, eppure anche oggi tirano avanti in Irva con la loro tenacia.

jp: 街に住む人々。日々の色々な困ったことを依頼に出している。近頃は、周辺諸国から侵攻があったりと物騒な世情をひしひしと感じている。
jp_grezzo: "街に住む人々。日々の色々な困ったことを依頼に出している。近頃は、周辺諸国から侵攻があったりと物騒な世情をひしひしと感じている。"
en: People living in the city. They submit requests for various daily problems. Recently, there have been invasions from neighbouring countries, and they are very much concerned about the state of affairs in the city.
en_grezzo: "People living in the city. They submit requests for various daily problems. Recently, there have been invasions from neighbouring countries, and they are very much concerned about the state of affairs in the city."
it: Gente che abita in città. I guai di ogni giorno, uno per uno, li mettono a bando come incarichi. Di recente ci sono state incursioni dai paesi vicini, e l'aria pesante che tira la sentono addosso tutta.

jp: 悪魔の称号を与えられたおそるべき昆虫。戦闘能力こそ低いものの、そのしぶとさと耐性と増殖力は恐怖に値する。困ったことに人懐っこい。
jp_grezzo: "悪魔の称号を与えられたおそるべき昆虫。戦闘能力こそ低いものの、そのしぶとさと耐性と増殖力は恐怖に値する。困ったことに人懐っこい。"
en: A fearsome insect given the title of demon. Although its fighting ability is low, its tenacity, resilience and ability to multiply are fearsome. Frustratingly, they are also very friendly.
en_grezzo: "A fearsome insect given the title of demon. Although its fighting ability is low, its tenacity, resilience and ability to multiply are fearsome. Frustratingly, they are also very friendly."
it: Un insetto tremendo, a cui è stato conferito il titolo di demone. In combattimento vale poco, ma la sua ostinazione, la sua resistenza e la sua capacità di moltiplicarsi meritano davvero paura. E la cosa fastidiosa è che è pure affettuoso.

jp: ガイアス・ヴィスと呼ばれる世界からやってきた少女。船が難破して死にかけていた旅人を救ったことがある。エルシアの民。
jp_grezzo: "ガイアス・ヴィスと呼ばれる世界からやってきた少女。船が難破して死にかけていた旅人を救ったことがある。エルシアの民。"
en: A girl from a world called Gaius Vis. She once saved a traveller who was dying when his ship was shipwrecked. Elea.
en_grezzo: "A girl from a world called Gaius Vis. She once saved a traveller who was dying when his ship was shipwrecked. Elea."
it: Una ragazza venuta da un mondo chiamato Gaius Vis. Una volta ha salvato un viaggiatore che stava morendo dopo un naufragio. È del popolo di Elsia.

jp: ガイアス・ヴィスと呼ばれる世界からやってきた。昔は頭の固い男だったがカルラの影響か最近ではだいぶ丸くなった。
jp_grezzo: "ガイアス・ヴィスと呼ばれる世界からやってきた。昔は頭の固い男だったがカルラの影響か最近ではだいぶ丸くなった。"
en: He comes from a world called Gaius Vis. He used to be a hard-headed man, but has recently become much more matured, probably due to Carla's influence.
en_grezzo: "He comes from a world called Gaius Vis. He used to be a hard-headed man, but has recently become much more matured, probably due to Carla's influence. "
it: Viene da un mondo chiamato Gaius Vis. Un tempo era un uomo di testa dura, ma ultimamente si è parecchio smussato, forse per l'influenza di Carla.

jp: 愛に飢えている義理の妹。妄想癖があり、兄（姉）とのえっちな生活を妄想してはひとりで鼻血を流している。そのせいか貧血気味らしい。
jp_grezzo: "愛に飢えている義理の妹。妄想癖があり、兄（姉）とのえっちな生活を妄想してはひとりで鼻血を流している。そのせいか貧血気味らしい。"
en: A younger sister who is desperate for love. She has a habit of daydreaming and gets nosebleeds alone when she fantasises about an ecchi life with her brother (or sister). She seems to be anaemic because of this.
en_grezzo: "A younger sister who is desperate for love. She has a habit of daydreaming and gets nosebleeds alone when she fantasises about an ecchi life with her brother (or sister). She seems to be anaemic because of this."
it: Una sorellastra affamata d'affetto. Ha il vizio di fantasticare, e mentre si immagina una vita spinta con il fratello (o la sorella) le viene da sola l'emorragia dal naso. Forse è per questo che tende all'anemia.

jp: レム・イドで研究されていた人工細菌の、オリジナル群体。本来は、全生命体を強化しある脅威に対抗するためのものだった。研究中のコードネームはメサイア。
jp_grezzo: "レム・イドで研究されていた人工細菌の、オリジナル群体。本来は、全生命体を強化しある脅威に対抗するためのものだった。研究中のコードネームはメサイア。"
en: The original swarm of artificial bacteria, which were being researched at Remido. It was originally intended to strengthen all life forms and counter certain threats. Code name during research was Messiah.
en_grezzo: "The original swarm of artificial bacteria, which were being researched at Remido. It was originally intended to strengthen all life forms and counter certain threats. Code name during research was Messiah."
it: La colonia originale dei batteri artificiali che si studiavano a Rehm-Ido. In origine dovevano potenziare ogni forma di vita per opporsi a una certa minaccia. Durante le ricerche il nome in codice era Messia.

jp: ５体の竜族が融合して産まれた。その圧倒的な力に魅せられた人々の畏敬を集め、もはや神としての側面すらもつ。一斉にブレスを吐くと酸欠になるため、一本ずつ交代で吐いている。
jp_grezzo: "５体の竜族が融合して産まれた。その圧倒的な力に魅せられた人々の畏敬を集め、もはや神としての側面すらもつ。一斉にブレスを吐くと酸欠になるため、一本ずつ交代で吐いている。"
en: It was born from the fusion of five dragons. They are revered by those who are fascinated by their overwhelming power, and even have the aspect of gods now. If they all breathe out their breath at the same time, they run out of oxygen, so they breathe out one by one in turn.
en_grezzo: "It was born from the fusion of five dragons. They are revered by those who are fascinated by their overwhelming power, and even have the aspect of gods now. If they all breathe out their breath at the same time, they run out of oxygen, so they breathe out one by one in turn."
it: È nato dalla fusione di cinque draghi. La sua forza schiacciante affascina la gente e ne raccoglie il timore, tanto che ormai ha perfino un lato divino. Se lanciassero il soffio tutte insieme le teste resterebbero senz'aria, e così soffiano a turno, una per volta.

jp: 何かに寄生されたかたつむり。自身の肉体の脆弱さを顧みない攻撃を放ってくるが、これはあえて捕食されることで宿主を変えようとする寄生体の意志によるもの。
jp_grezzo: "何かに寄生されたかたつむり。自身の肉体の脆弱さを顧みない攻撃を放ってくるが、これはあえて捕食されることで宿主を変えようとする寄生体の意志によるもの。"
en: A snail parasitised by something. It unleashes attacks without regard for its own physical vulnerability, but this is due to the parasite's will to change its host by daring to prey on it.
en_grezzo: "A snail parasitised by something. It unleashes attacks without regard for its own physical vulnerability, but this is due to the parasite's will to change its host by daring to prey on it. "
it: Una lumaca in cui si è annidato qualcosa. Attacca senza alcun riguardo per la fragilità del proprio corpo, ma è la volontà del parassita, che si fa predare apposta per cambiare ospite.

jp: 年を経た鳥が変異した。不死鳥や鳳凰と同一視されるのが大嫌い。朱い雀という名前だが、さすがに雀に間違われることはないようだ。
jp_grezzo: "年を経た鳥が変異した。不死鳥や鳳凰と同一視されるのが大嫌い。朱い雀という名前だが、さすがに雀に間違われることはないようだ。"
en: Mutated age-old birds. It hates being identified with phoenixes and phoenixes. Although its name is Vermilion Sparrow, it does not seem to be mistaken for a sparrow, as one would expect.
en_grezzo: "Mutated age-old birds. It hates being identified with phoenixes and phoenixes. Although its name is Vermilion Sparrow, it does not seem to be mistaken for a sparrow, as one would expect."
it: È un uccello molto vecchio che è mutato. Odia da morire che lo si confonda con l'araba fenice o con la fenice d'oriente. Il suo nome dice passero vermiglio, ma per un passero, questo è certo, non lo scambia nessuno.

jp: 鶏の怪物。その視線を浴びた者は体がまるで石になったかのように動けなくなってしまう。そのことから『目を合わせたら死ぬ』とまで言われている。
jp_grezzo: "鶏の怪物。その視線を浴びた者は体がまるで石になったかのように動けなくなってしまう。そのことから『目を合わせたら死ぬ』とまで言われている。"
en: Chicken monster. Those who are exposed to its gaze are rendered immobile as if their bodies had turned to stone. It is even said that 'if you make eye contact with it, you will die'.
en_grezzo: "Chicken monster. Those who are exposed to its gaze are rendered immobile as if their bodies had turned to stone. It is even said that 'if you make eye contact with it, you will die'."
it: Un mostro a forma di gallo. Chi ne riceve lo sguardo non riesce più a muoversi, come se il corpo gli si fosse fatto di pietra. Per questo si dice perfino che chi incrocia i suoi occhi muore.

jp: 金色に輝く毛並みを持つ珍しい羊。光を受けて黄金色に輝いて見える、繊細な純白の毛は、かつて人々に争いを起こさせたこともあるほど。
jp_grezzo: "金色に輝く毛並みを持つ珍しい羊。光を受けて黄金色に輝いて見える、繊細な純白の毛は、かつて人々に争いを起こさせたこともあるほど。"
en: A rare sheep with a golden fleece. Its delicate, pure white fleece, which appears golden in the light, once caused people to fight over it.
en_grezzo: "A rare sheep with a golden fleece. Its delicate, pure white fleece, which appears golden in the light, once caused people to fight over it. "
it: Una pecora rara, dal vello che riluce d'oro. Quel pelo candido e sottile, che alla luce sembra oro colato, un tempo arrivò a far scoppiare una guerra fra gli uomini.

jp: 竜族に飼育されている鳥人種。通常のハーピーより凶暴性を増しており、攻撃すれば万華鏡を当てたかのように分裂する性質も合わせて多くの冒険者を苦しめている。
jp_grezzo: "竜族に飼育されている鳥人種。通常のハーピーより凶暴性を増しており、攻撃すれば万華鏡を当てたかのように分裂する性質も合わせて多くの冒険者を苦しめている。"
en: A bird race bred by the dragon tribe. They are more ferocious than regular harpies, and their tendency to split apart when attacked, as if hit with a kaleidoscope, has caused many adventurers distress.
en_grezzo: "A bird race bred by the dragon tribe. They are more ferocious than regular harpies, and their tendency to split apart when attacked, as if hit with a kaleidoscope, has caused many adventurers distress. "
it: Una razza di uomini uccello allevata dai draghi. È più feroce di un'arpia comune, e per giunta, se la si attacca, si moltiplica come in un caleidoscopio: due doti che hanno fatto penare molti avventurieri.

jp: 非常に大きなエネルギー源を秘めた動く岩。外部からの刺激によって大きな光と爆発を発生させる。その爆発は小さな太陽と見紛うほど。
jp_grezzo: "非常に大きなエネルギー源を秘めた動く岩。外部からの刺激によって大きな光と爆発を発生させる。その爆発は小さな太陽と見紛うほど。"
en: A moving rock with a tremendous energy source. It produces large bursts of light and explosions when stimulated from the outside. The explosions can be mistaken for a small sun.
en_grezzo: "A moving rock with a tremendous energy source. It produces large bursts of light and explosions when stimulated from the outside. The explosions can be mistaken for a small sun."
it: Una roccia semovente che nasconde dentro di sé una fonte di energia enorme. A uno stimolo esterno produce una gran luce e un'esplosione, e quell'esplosione la si scambia per un piccolo sole.

jp: 地獄から地上の支配を目論んだ冥王が作り上げた巨人。トロールと似た姿をしているが比べ物にならないほど知能が高く、独自の言葉を使って会話を行える。
jp_grezzo: "地獄から地上の支配を目論んだ冥王が作り上げた巨人。トロールと似た姿をしているが比べ物にならないほど知能が高く、独自の言葉を使って会話を行える。"
en: Titans created by the Dark Lord, who planned to rule the earth from hell. They look like trolls, but are incomparably more intelligent and can speak their own language.
en_grezzo: "Titans created by the Dark Lord, who planned to rule the earth from hell. They look like trolls, but are incomparably more intelligent and can speak their own language. "
it: Un gigante creato dal signore dell'oltretomba, che dall'inferno puntava a dominare la superficie. Somiglia al troll, ma è intelligente in un modo che non regge il confronto, e sa conversare in una lingua tutta sua.

jp: 発達した鋏は挟む力が非常に強く人間の腕程度なら輪切りに出来てしまう。名前に反し雑食性で、果実や草、動物などの口に入るものなら何でも食べてしまう。
jp_grezzo: "発達した鋏は挟む力が非常に強く人間の腕程度なら輪切りに出来てしまう。名前に反し雑食性で、果実や草、動物などの口に入るものなら何でも食べてしまう。"
en: Its well-developed scissors have a very strong pinching force and can slice a Indian Elephant in a circle. Despite their name, they are omnivorous and will eat anything they can get their mouths on, including fruit, grass and animals.
en_grezzo: "Its well-developed scissors have a very strong pinching force and can slice a Indian Elephant in a circle. Despite their name, they are omnivorous and will eat anything they can get their mouths on, including fruit, grass and animals. "
it: Le chele, molto sviluppate, stringono con una forza tale da tranciare a fette un braccio d'uomo. A dispetto del nome è onnivoro: frutta, erba, animali, tutto quel che gli entra in bocca.

jp: 屈強な竜人の戦士。非常に高い知性と鱗に覆われた頑強な身体を持っており、下級戦士のリザードマンと間違われる事をとても嫌う。
jp_grezzo: "屈強な竜人の戦士。非常に高い知性と鱗に覆われた頑強な身体を持っており、下級戦士のリザードマンと間違われる事をとても嫌う。"
en: A formidable dragon-man warrior. They have extremely high intelligence and a robust body covered with scales, and they very much dislike being mistaken for lower-ranked warrior lizardmen.
en_grezzo: "A formidable dragon-man warrior. They have extremely high intelligence and a robust body covered with scales, and they very much dislike being mistaken for lower-ranked warrior lizardmen. "
it: Un guerriero dragonewt di gran vigore. Ha un'intelligenza altissima e un corpo robusto coperto di scaglie, e detesta moltissimo essere scambiato per un uomo lucertola, che è un guerriero di rango inferiore.

jp: 様々な魔法を使いこなし、自身は多種の属性に耐性を持つ。立派な女王になっても、悪戯心を忘れないのが妖精の嗜みである。
jp_grezzo: "様々な魔法を使いこなし、自身は多種の属性に耐性を持つ。立派な女王になっても、悪戯心を忘れないのが妖精の嗜みである。"
en: She is skilled in a variety of magic and is herself resistant to many different attributes. Even after becoming a respectable queen, she still has the mischievous spirit of a fairy.
en_grezzo: "She is skilled in a variety of magic and is herself resistant to many different attributes. Even after becoming a respectable queen, she still has the mischievous spirit of a fairy. "
it: Padroneggia magie di ogni sorta, e lei stessa resiste a parecchi elementi. Anche diventata una regina in piena regola non dimentica lo spirito burlone: è il buon gusto delle fate.

jp: 悪魔の如き強さを持つ小鬼。下位の巨人を楽にねじ伏せることができるほどの力を持ちながら、さらに群れを組んで襲ってくる。
jp_grezzo: "悪魔の如き強さを持つ小鬼。下位の巨人を楽にねじ伏せることができるほどの力を持ちながら、さらに群れを組んで襲ってくる。"
en: A kobold with the strength of a demon. They are powerful enough to wrangle an Indian Elephant with ease, and they also attack in packs.
en_grezzo: "A kobold with the strength of a demon. They are powerful enough to wrangle an Indian Elephant with ease, and they also attack in packs. "
it: Un coboldo con la forza di un demone. Ha una potenza che gli basta a piegare senza fatica un gigante di rango inferiore, e per giunta assale in branco.

jp: 水の女神の名を冠する蛙の狩人。狙った相手に卵を植え付けながらも殺しに掛かってくる。生き残った強いものからは、さぞかし強い子が生まれるのだろう。
jp_grezzo: "水の女神の名を冠する蛙の狩人。狙った相手に卵を植え付けながらも殺しに掛かってくる。生き残った強いものからは、さぞかし強い子が生まれるのだろう。"
en: Frog hunter named after the water goddess. It will try to kill its target while planting eggs on them. The strong ones that survive will give birth to their strong offspring.
en_grezzo: "Frog hunter named after the water goddess. It will try to kill its target while planting eggs on them. The strong ones that survive will give birth to their strong offspring."
it: Una cacciatrice rana che porta il nome della dea dell'acqua. Alla preda che ha puntato impianta le uova, e insieme cerca di ucciderla. Da chi è tanto forte da sopravviverle nasceranno figli fortissimi, c'è da crederci.

jp: エーテルの影響で翼の生えたかたつむり。意外と口が悪い。鈍いのは動きだけではないらしく、好意を向けられてもなかなか気がつかない。
jp_grezzo: "エーテルの影響で翼の生えたかたつむり。意外と口が悪い。鈍いのは動きだけではないらしく、好意を向けられてもなかなか気がつかない。"
en: A snail that has grown wings under the influence of the ether wind. Surprisingly foul-mouthed. It seems that it is not only his movements that are slow, and he does not easily notice when favours are shown to him.
en_grezzo: "A snail that has grown wings under the influence of the ether wind. Surprisingly foul-mouthed. It seems that it is not only his movements that are slow, and he does not easily notice when favours are shown to him."
it: Una lumaca a cui l'etere ha fatto spuntare le ali. Ha una linguaccia che non ti aspetti. E a quanto pare non è lenta soltanto nei movimenti: se qualcuno le mostra dell'affetto, ci mette un bel po' ad accorgersene.

jp: 機械文明時代の飛行ユニットを鹵獲・解析して開発された。主に兵士の飛行装備兼、掩護用として運用される。自律回路により単独行動も可能。
jp_grezzo: "機械文明時代の飛行ユニットを鹵獲・解析して開発された。主に兵士の飛行装備兼、掩護用として運用される。自律回路により単独行動も可能。"
en: It was developed by capturing and analysing flight units from the age of mechanical civilisation. It is mainly used as flying equipment and cover for soldiers. It can also act independently using autonomous circuits.
en_grezzo: "It was developed by capturing and analysing flight units from the age of mechanical civilisation. It is mainly used as flying equipment and cover for soldiers. It can also act independently using autonomous circuits."
it: L'hanno sviluppato catturando e analizzando le unità di volo della civiltà meccanica. Serve soprattutto ai soldati come equipaggiamento di volo e come copertura. Grazie ai circuiti autonomi può agire anche da solo.

jp: 天使と悪魔、それぞれの霊が融合して生まれた死霊の神。その翼に秘められたパワーは計り知れない。その誕生には一人の魔術師が関わっているという。
jp_grezzo: "天使と悪魔、それぞれの霊が融合して生まれた死霊の神。その翼に秘められたパワーは計り知れない。その誕生には一人の魔術師が関わっているという。"
en: A god of the dead, born from the amalgamation of the spirits of angels and demons, respectively. The power hidden in its wings is immeasurable. Its birth is said to be related to a certain sorcerer.
en_grezzo: "A god of the dead, born from the amalgamation of the spirits of angels and demons, respectively. The power hidden in its wings is immeasurable. Its birth is said to be related to a certain sorcerer."
it: Un dio degli spiriti dei morti, nato dalla fusione dello spirito di un angelo e di quello di un demone. La potenza nascosta in quelle ali non si può misurare. Si dice che alla sua nascita abbia preso parte un mago.

jp: イェルス軍の開発した大型空戦兵器。要塞の地下に格納されていたが、要塞が地殻変動によってネフィアと融合した際に中枢へと放り出された。
jp_grezzo: "イェルス軍の開発した大型空戦兵器。要塞の地下に格納されていたが、要塞が地殻変動によってネフィアと融合した際に中枢へと放り出された。"
en: A large air combat weapon developed by the Yerles military. It was stored in the basement of the fortress, but was thrown out into the central core when the fortress was fused with Nefia by a tectonic movement.
en_grezzo: "A large air combat weapon developed by the Yerles military. It was stored in the basement of the fortress, but was thrown out into the central core when the fortress was fused with Nefia by a tectonic movement. "
it: Una grande arma da combattimento aereo sviluppata dall'esercito di Yerles. Era custodita nei sotterranei della fortezza, ma quando i movimenti della crosta fusero la fortezza con una Nefia, finì scaraventata nel suo cuore.

jp: 地下にいながら太陽の光を操る冥界の守護者。自らの治める黄泉の谷へと死者を導き、その罪を量る。昔は神のような力を持っていたが現在はそうでもない。
jp_grezzo: "地下にいながら太陽の光を操る冥界の守護者。自らの治める黄泉の谷へと死者を導き、その罪を量る。昔は神のような力を持っていたが現在はそうでもない。"
en: Guardian of the underworld who controls the light of the sun while underground. He leads the dead to the Valley of the Dead, where he reigns, and weighs their sins. He used to have god-like powers, but not so much nowadays.
en_grezzo: "Guardian of the underworld who controls the light of the sun while underground. He leads the dead to the Valley of the Dead, where he reigns, and weighs their sins. He used to have god-like powers, but not so much nowadays."
it: Il guardiano dell'oltretomba che, pur stando sottoterra, governa la luce del sole. Conduce i morti alla Valle degli Inferi, su cui regna, e ne pesa le colpe. Un tempo aveva poteri da dio, oggi non più di tanto.

jp: ハイレベルのリッチによって命を吹き込まれた腐ったドラゴンの死体。魔法で強化されているものの、筋肉が腐っているためあまり力はない。
jp_grezzo: "ハイレベルのリッチによって命を吹き込まれた腐ったドラゴンの死体。魔法で強化されているものの、筋肉が腐っているためあまり力はない。"
en: Rotting dragon corpses brought to life by high-level lich. Although magically enhanced, they are not very strong due to rotting muscles.
en_grezzo: "Rotting dragon corpses brought to life by high-level lich. Although magically enhanced, they are not very strong due to rotting muscles. "
it: Il cadavere putrefatto di un drago a cui un lich di alto livello ha soffiato dentro la vita. La magia lo rinforza, ma con i muscoli marci di forza ne ha poca.

jp: この生き物はこの世界のものではない。どこからか不思議な力が湧いて出るようである。動力も不明。きゅうきゅう鳴くが、どこから声が出ているのだろう。
jp_grezzo: "この生き物はこの世界のものではない。どこからか不思議な力が湧いて出るようである。動力も不明。きゅうきゅう鳴くが、どこから声が出ているのだろう。"
en: This creature is not of this world. Mysterious power seems to emanate out of it from somewhere. Its power source is also unknown. It cries, but where does it get its voice from?
en_grezzo: "This creature is not of this world. Mysterious power seems to emanate out of it from somewhere. Its power source is also unknown. It cries, but where does it get its voice from?"
it: Questa creatura non è di questo mondo. Pare che da qualche parte le sgorghi un potere misterioso. E nemmeno si sa che cosa la muova. Squittisce, ma da dove esca quella voce è un mistero.

jp: 頑固なボール職人にどうにか取り入ることに成功し、モンスターボールを直接買いつけている。あまり流通していないためほぼ独占状態である。
jp_grezzo: "頑固なボール職人にどうにか取り入ることに成功し、モンスターボールを直接買いつけている。あまり流通していないためほぼ独占状態である。"
en: He has managed to get hold of stubborn ball-makers and buys monster balls directly from them. As they are not widely distributed, they have a near-monopoly on them.
en_grezzo: "He has managed to get hold of stubborn ball-makers and buys monster balls directly from them. As they are not widely distributed, they have a near-monopoly on them. "
it: È riuscito in qualche modo a ingraziarsi un testardo artigiano di sfere, e da lui compra le sfere dei mostri di prima mano. In commercio se ne trovano poche, e così ha quasi il monopolio.

jp: 田舎出身であることがコンプレックスで、若いころに村を飛び出し商人になった。一時は大金持ちになったものの調子に乗りすぎて事業に失敗してしまった。
jp_grezzo: "田舎出身であることがコンプレックスで、若いころに村を飛び出し商人になった。一時は大金持ちになったものの調子に乗りすぎて事業に失敗してしまった。"
en: He had a country-born complex and left his village when he was young to become a merchant. He became very rich for a while but got overzealous and his business failed.
en_grezzo: "He had a country-born complex and left his village when he was young to become a merchant. He became very rich for a while but got overzealous and his business failed. "
it: Aveva il complesso delle proprie origini di campagna, e da giovane scappò dal villaggio per farsi mercante. Per un po' fu ricchissimo, ma montandosi troppo la testa mandò in rovina i suoi affari.

jp: 浴び続け染み込んだ返り血によって黒ずんだ体毛を持つ。「窮鼠猫を噛む」という古い言葉があるが、このネズミにかかれば猫が獲物となる。
jp_grezzo: "浴び続け染み込んだ返り血によって黒ずんだ体毛を持つ。「窮鼠猫を噛む」という古い言葉があるが、このネズミにかかれば猫が獲物となる。"
en: It has body hair darkened by the reflux of blood that it is continually exposed to and soaks up. The old saying goes 'a cornered rat will bite a cat', and with this rat, the cat is the prey.
en_grezzo: "It has body hair darkened by the reflux of blood that it is continually exposed to and soaks up. The old saying goes 'a cornered rat will bite a cat', and with this rat, the cat is the prey. "
it: Ha il pelo incupito dal sangue altrui, che gli schizza addosso di continuo e gli si è impregnato dentro. C'è un vecchio detto per cui il topo alle strette morde il gatto, ma con questo ratto è il gatto a diventare la preda.

jp: 主に防衛拠点に設置されている。開発主任の趣味で、過剰とも思える火力のガトリング砲を搭載された試作機体が存在する。
jp_grezzo: "主に防衛拠点に設置されている。開発主任の趣味で、過剰とも思える火力のガトリング砲を搭載された試作機体が存在する。"
en: They are mainly installed in defensive positions. Prototype aircraft equipped with Gatling guns with seemingly excessive firepower exist, as a hobby of the chief developer.
en_grezzo: "They are mainly installed in defensive positions. Prototype aircraft equipped with Gatling guns with seemingly excessive firepower exist, as a hobby of the chief developer. "
it: Lo si installa soprattutto nelle postazioni di difesa. Ne esiste un prototipo che, per il gusto personale del capo progettista, monta un cannone Gatling dalla potenza di fuoco che pare eccessiva.

jp: スライムが宇宙からやってきた謎の物体を取り込み変異した。細胞が酷く不安定で、ちょっとしたショックで変質してしまう。
jp_grezzo: "スライムが宇宙からやってきた謎の物体を取り込み変異した。細胞が酷く不安定で、ちょっとしたショックで変質してしまう。"
en: The slime has taken in a mysterious object from outer space and mutated. The cells are severely unstable and a slight shock causes them to transform.
en_grezzo: "The slime has taken in a mysterious object from outer space and mutated. The cells are severely unstable and a slight shock causes them to transform. "
it: Una melma che ha inglobato un oggetto misterioso venuto dallo spazio ed è mutata. Le sue cellule sono di un'instabilità tremenda, e basta un piccolo urto perché si trasformi.

jp: 元々静電気を蓄えやすかった体毛が、何故か攻撃に使用出来るほどに帯電してしまった羊。動くたびにバリバリと激しい音を発する。
jp_grezzo: "元々静電気を蓄えやすかった体毛が、何故か攻撃に使用出来るほどに帯電してしまった羊。動くたびにバリバリと激しい音を発する。"
en: A sheep whose body hair, originally prone to storing static electricity, has somehow become so charged that it can be used to attack. Whenever it moves, it emits a loud, crackling sound.
en_grezzo: "A sheep whose body hair, originally prone to storing static electricity, has somehow become so charged that it can be used to attack. Whenever it moves, it emits a loud, crackling sound. "
it: Una pecora il cui pelo, già di suo incline ad accumulare elettricità statica, chissà come si è caricato al punto da poter servire per attaccare. A ogni movimento manda un crepitio violento.

jp: 非常に落ち着きがなくそそっかしいメイド。出稼ぎで都会に出てきたはいいものの、それから間もなく主が破産したため路頭に迷っている。
jp_grezzo: "非常に落ち着きがなくそそっかしいメイド。出稼ぎで都会に出てきたはいいものの、それから間もなく主が破産したため路頭に迷っている。"
en: A very restless and fidgety maid. She came to the city as a migrant worker, but soon afterwards she found herself on the street because her owner went bankrupt.
en_grezzo: "A very restless and fidgety maid. She came to the city as a migrant worker, but soon afterwards she found herself on the street because her owner went bankrupt. "
it: Una cameriera irrequieta e sbadata da non dirsi. Era venuta in città a cercare lavoro, ma poco dopo il suo padrone è fallito e adesso si ritrova sulla strada.

jp: 屋敷を彩る花。鑑定・訓練・仲間の調査などもそつなくこなすプロフェッショナルだが、料理は苦手。主人によっては男のメイドさんだけ酷い扱いを受ける。
jp_grezzo: "屋敷を彩る花。鑑定・訓練・仲間の調査などもそつなくこなすプロフェッショナルだが、料理は苦手。主人によっては男のメイドさんだけ酷い扱いを受ける。"
en: Blossoms that adorn the mansion. A professional who can appraise, train and investigate her peers with perfection, but she is not a great chef. Only male maids are treated badly by some masters.
en_grezzo: "Blossoms that adorn the mansion. A professional who can appraise, train and investigate her peers with perfection, but she is not a great chef. Only male maids are treated badly by some masters."
it: Il fiore che adorna la magione. È una professionista che sbriga senza sbavature l'identificazione, l'addestramento e l'esame dei compagni, ma in cucina è negata. E con certi padroni sono solo le cameriere maschio a essere trattate male.

jp: かつて地上を支配していた神々の末裔。同胞たちが今の神によって地底に押し込められているため、激しい怨みを抱えている。
jp_grezzo: "かつて地上を支配していた神々の末裔。同胞たちが今の神によって地底に押し込められているため、激しい怨みを抱えている。"
en: Descendants of the gods who once ruled the earth. They carry intense resentment because their brethren have been forced underground by the current gods.
en_grezzo: "Descendants of the gods who once ruled the earth. They carry intense resentment because their brethren have been forced underground by the current gods. "
it: Discendenti delle divinità che un tempo dominavano la superficie. I loro fratelli sono stati ricacciati nelle viscere della terra dalle divinità di adesso, e per questo covano un rancore feroce.
